name: Olbia (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Olbia (a sailing ship before a mountain) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Olbia, a comune in Sardinia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 18 November 1955.

features.role: Olbia arms — sailing ship before a mountain, crowned, within branches
